slides.headline: GROK CAN NOW LOG INTO YOUR ACCOUNTS AND ACT FOR YOU
1) LET GROK LOG IN AND WORK YOUR INBOX
slides.body:
It uses your real Chrome with your existing logins. No passwords shared.

"Open my Gmail. List every client email from this week with sender name, subject, and whether I replied."

slides.headline: 2) SCAN COMPETITOR PRICES ACROSS 10 SITES AT ONCE
slides.body:
Grok opens their websites live and pulls whatever you need. Takes 3 minutes, not 3 hours.

"Visit [competitor URL]. List their prices, current promotions, and what their homepage says their main offer is."

slides.headline: 3) FILL GOVERNMENT FORMS ONLINE WHILE YOU SLEEP
slides.body:
Use the isolated cloud browser. No logins required. Paste your details once and let it work.

"Go to [form URL]. Fill it using: Name: [X], Business: [X], EIN: [X]. Submit when complete."

slides.headline: 4) FIND THE CHEAPEST FLIGHT FOR ANY BUSINESS TRIP
slides.body:
Grok opens Kayak, Expedia, and Google Flights live and finds the lowest price.

"Find flights from [city] to [city] on [date]. List the 3 cheapest options with airline and price."

slides.headline: 5) PULL LEAD LISTS FROM ANY BUSINESS DIRECTORY
slides.body:
Point Grok at a local business directory. It scrapes names, numbers, and emails. Free leads in minutes.

"Go to [directory URL]. List every business name, phone number, and email address on this page."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 5 GROK BUILD BROWSER TASKS
slides.body:
Let Grok into your inbox
Scan competitor prices live

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe through 🔓 Grok Build added a real browser today, and these 5 tasks are the ones your business should try first.

Log into your Chrome with existing logins and read your inbox, scan live competitor websites for prices and offers, fill government forms using the isolated cloud browser, find the cheapest business flights across booking sites, pull business contact lists from any online directory.

AI just crossed into your browser. When it can log into your real accounts and act on your behalf, it stops being a chatbot. This plugin launched today and most businesses haven't touched it yet.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this does for yours.

Sources: xAI (Grok Build Browser Use plugin announcement), Browser Use
